restorationLaw: exact trigger, then the stable workflow target, then the workspace; a non-exact restore reports ui.stale_owner

cases.subject: cancel restores to the exact trigger
cases.given: the New chart dialog opened from the header Clear button and cancelled
cases.expected: focus returns to the Clear button; no other state changes

cases.subject: workflow target when the trigger is gone
cases.given: a dialog whose trigger unmounted while open
cases.expected: focus falls to the dialog's stable workflow target, then the workspace; the fallback is exact, never document.body

cases.subject: non-exact restore reports the refusal
cases.given: a restore whose recorded owner token is stale
cases.expected: the refusal ui.stale_owner reaches the contract-refusal channel; focus still lands on the lawful fallback

cases.subject: cancel, failure, and success restore identically
cases.given: the import dialog closed by cancel, by a failed commit, and by a successful commit
cases.expected: all three restore focus by the same law; failure and success never strand focus in a closing dialog

cases.subject: lifecycle dialogs never disturb chart selection
cases.given: a selection and range in the chart when any lifecycle dialog opens and closes
cases.expected: bookmarks.selection and bookmarks.range are byte-for-byte equal afterwards; roving focus resumes at the same identity

cases.subject: mobile sheet nests under the one modal root
cases.given: the export sheet open on a narrow viewport
cases.expected: the sheet is the single modal scope; a second modal refuses; closing the sheet restores its trigger

cases.subject: exactly one announcement per transition
cases.given: dialog open, refusal, and settlement transitions
cases.expected: each transition announces exactly once through the live region; the status strip uses role=status and never interrupts

cases.subject: focus never lands in inert background
cases.given: a modal dialog with the document made inert outside the surface
cases.expected: Tab cycles inside the dialog; background is unreachable by keyboard and pointer until dismissal
